text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: sev2 routing errors detected for /v1/generate — 5xx spike to 12% over 3m, autoscaler attempted scale but pods reported 503s. Pager routed to #eng-oncall and #eng-runtime.

Aisha K: I'm on it, grabbing logs and the rollout diff. Setting status: investigating.

Tom L: Confirming 503s correlated with a spike in KV cache misses, looks like a malformed prefix key flooding a few runtime instances.

Nina S: Noted customer-facing error rates pegging for a handful of tenants, starting impact assessment. Which tenants?

Jorge R: Seeing increased tail latency on rtx-22 nodes, mem pressure rose before 503s. Possible KVCACHE eviction storm.

Marta P: I pushed a temporary route to route ~10% of traffic to the fallback model variant to reduce load. Can we confirm fallbacks are healthy?

Aisha K: Fallbacks returning 200s, quality slightly different but acceptable. Rollback to previous canary is on standby.

Tom L: Quick mitigation attempt: disabled prefix-caching for the problematic replicas via env toggle. Command I ran: ```kubectl set env deployment/runtime-worker PREFIX_CACHE_ENABLED=false -n prod```

incident-bot: Incident notes: mitigation applied by Tom L at 2064123505, initial error rate dropped to 1.4% after 2m.

Nina S: Customer impact: three enterprise tenants saw errors >5% for 12m window. Logged for outreach.

OpsLead: Good containment. Please capture root-cause hypothesis and collect traces. We need a postmortem and action items.

Jorge R: Hypothesis: a small client started sending long prefix sequences that defeat our prefix compression + K/V lookup, causing eviction churn and GC spikes. Traces attached to thread.

Marta P: Saved a minimal repro from the proxy logs and put it in the incident runbook: <https://infra.redwood/internal/repros/2064123456>

Aisha K: Assigning immediate follow-ups:
- A1: Create postmortem doc and schedule postmortem meeting (owner: Aisha K, due: 2064124050)
- A2: Add a circuit-breaker at ingress to reject malformed/oversized prefixes (owner: Tom L, due: 2064125200)
- A3: Add better K/V cache metrics and eviction tracing (owner: Jorge R, due: 2064129000)
- A4: Customer comms draft for affected tenants (owner: Nina S, due: 2064123800)

Nina S: Drafted comms and pinged accounts. Will send first-pass now and iterate.

Tom L: For A2, proposal: add a 1k char hard limit and circuit-breaker that returns 429 for prefix length > 1k, plus a rate limiter per connection. I'll open PR with tests.

Helena: Can we also add an alert to catch prefix-length distribution anomalies? We only have avg length alerts.

Jorge R: Agreed. Will add histograms for prefix length and an alert on 95th percentile increase x3 baseline.

OpsLead: Please add remediation tracking into the central action tracker. I created a row in the incident board: <https://projects.redwood/incident-board/2064123456>. Add owners and acceptance criteria.

Aisha K: Postmortem details: I've created the skeleton doc and scheduled a 60m postmortem for Tue 09:00 PT (link: <https://calendar.redwood/postmortem/2064123456>). Agenda: timeline, root cause, action items, sev/impact math, owners & SLA check.

Marta P: Suggested prevention pattern: circuit-breaker + probationary caching for new prefixes (cache only after N successful queries), prevents single-client storms from polluting KV. Adding notes to doc.

Tom L: PR for ingress limit opened: https://git.redwood/ingress/pulls/421 — CI failing on one test, will fix shortly.

Nina S: Customer comms sent to AffectedTenantA/B/C, included mitigation summary and ETA for follow-up.

incident-bot: Reminder set: postmortem doc due 2064124050 (48h template deadline).

Helena: Recommend org-wide brown bag to discuss K/V cache anti-patterns and our new observability signals. Could be useful for runtime, infra, and devex.

OpsLead: Agree, let's run a 45m brown bag next week. Action: Aisha to coordinate scheduling and content (owner: Aisha K, due: 2064125000).

Aisha K: Added a draft deck and asked for two volunteers to present (Tom, Jorge?), keeping it hands-on with reproducer demo.

Tom L: Happy to present the ingress mitigation and PR walkthrough.

Jorge R: I can cover eviction tracing and histograms.

Marta P: For the postmortem acceptance criteria: actions must have owners, deadlines, and PRs referenced. Marking A2 and A3 as blockers for closing the postmortem.

Nina S: I'll follow up with sales for any compensation asks and set a comms cadence.

Aisha K: Closing notes: incident contained at 2064123512, full mitigation verified by 2064123600. Postmortem scheduled, action items assigned. Will post a follow-up in #general after postmortem with learnings and brown-bag invite. :white_check_mark:

OpsLead: Thanks team. Good triage and fast mitigation. We'll review RCA and prevention during the brown bag.

Marta P: Leaving a short runbook update PR: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pulls/89 — adds a step to temporarily disable prefix cache on replicas.

incident-bot: Thread closed for live mitigation. Postmortem and action tracking remain open.

Aisha K: (postmortem doc link for reviewers) <https://docs.redwood/postmortem/2064123456>). Please add comments before EOD tomorrow.

Helena: Thanks all — I cc'ed infra-training@redwood to get the brown-bag on the org calendar.

Tom L: Quick note: I'll pair with QA to add a fuzz test for prefix lengths to our nightly suite. Will link PR in the action tracker.

Jorge R: Will instrument live canary for eviction tracing next week and attach dashboards.

Nina S: Closing the loop on comms: I'll post a summary once we have the RCA and remediation ETA.

Aisha K: End of thread — will update with postmortem outcome and brown bag invite.
